Corollary
[Local minimum principle] 1. ch9:9.21\group chapter-9Source: gilbarg-trudinger:page-0258 Let $u\in W^{2,n}(\Omega )$ satisfy $Lu\le f$, or $Lu=f$, with $f\in L^n(\Omega )$. For every $B_{2R}(y)\subset \Omega $ and $p>0$, egin{equation} ag {9.50} \sup _{B_R(y)}(-u)\le C\left[ \left( rac1{|B_{2R}|}\int _{B_{2R}(y)}(u^-)^p ight)^{1/p} + rac R\lambda \| f\| _{L^n(B_{2R}(y))} ight], \end{equation} where $C=C(n,\gamma , u R^2,p)$.
Proof

\sketch Apply Theorem 43 to $-u$.

□

In particular, if $Lu\ge 0$ and $u\ge 0$ in $B_R(y)$, then egin{equation} ag {9.51} u(y)\le rac C{R^n}\int _{B_R(y)}u, \end{equation} where $C=C(n,\gamma , u R^2)$.
